definitions.gloss: national politics, national government, affairs of state
definitions.explanation: The political affairs and governance of a nation at the central level, as opposed to local or regional politics. Used in formal and journalistic contexts to discuss national-level political matters.

examples.japanese: {国政|こくせい}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A national election will be held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{国政|こくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進出|しんしゅつ}→進出：14387_shinshutsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She moved from local politics to national politics.

examples.japanese: {国政|こくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦{一人一人|ひとりひとり}→一人一人：03711_hitorihitori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: For citizens to participate in national politics, it is important that each individual take an interest in political affairs.

notes:
USAGE:
{国政|こくせい} refers specifically to politics at the national level, distinguishing it from ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧ (local politics). It is commonly seen in news and political discourse.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国政|こくせい}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: national election
- {国政|こくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to participate in national politics
- {国政|こくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進出|しんしゅつ}→進出：14387_shinshutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to enter national politics
- {国政|こくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|にな}う→担う：12787_ninau⟧: to bear responsibility for national governance
